body.statement: For a feasible one-stratum binary null with nonconstant \(Y\), \(C_P(0)=e_x(1-e_x)(p_1-p_0)^2/[m(1-m)]=\operatorname{Corr}_P(Z,Y)^2\); if the null odds inequalities fail, then \(C_P(0)=+\infty\).
body.justification: The identity gives a directly interpretable assignment-information price for erasing a binary association.
body.gap: No inspected sensitivity result identifies the feasible sharp null cost with the observed squared correlation while retaining the odds cap.
body.consumer: Applied readers can benchmark the null budget on the familiar correlation scale and detect when the null is impossible at every finite budget.
